source_name: NBS – Analytické komentáre (Analytical Comments)
why_relevant: Short analyst-authored notes on topical issues; the natural home for one-off analyses of payment behaviour, card/contactless adoption, cash demand shocks and digital euro. Charts here are often not reproducible from the statistics portal.

source_name: NBS – Rýchle komentáre (Quick Comments)
why_relevant: Rapid-reaction notes published alongside data releases; useful for catching NBS's own interpretation/revision narrative within days of a statistical publication.

source_name: NBS – Čo hovoria dáta (What the Data Say)
why_relevant: Explicitly data-storytelling series: takes NBS/ECB micro and macro datasets and turns them into charted narratives. High likelihood of card/cash/payment-behaviour visualisations that do not exist elsewhere.

source_name: NBS – Blogy NBS (NBS Blog)
why_relevant: Least-formal narrative channel; carries staff pieces on cash usage and payment digitalisation (e.g. 'Hotovosť neumiera'). Often the earliest public airing of an internal analysis.

source_name: NBS – Aktuality / press releases
why_relevant: Primary press-release stream. Historically the channel for payment-market interventions and interpretation: contactless limit raise from EUR 20 to EUR 50 (agreed with the Slovak Banking Association), instant-payments rollout, access of non-bank PSPs to SIPS/TARGET-SK, digital euro communication.

source_name: NBS – Správa o činnosti útvaru dohľadu nad finančným trhom (Financial Market Supervision Activity Report)
why_relevant: Annual supervision report covering supervised entities including payment institutions and e-money institutions; documents licensing, enforcement and market-structure changes on the payments side that never appear in statistical tables.

source_name: NBS – Správa o činnosti útvaru dohľadu v oblasti ochrany spotrebiteľa (consumer-protection supervision report)
why_relevant: Consumer-protection strand of supervision; complaints and findings about current accounts, payment services, card products and unauthorised transactions — an indirect read on real-world payment-product friction and volumes.

source_name: NBS – Makroprudenciálny komentár (Macroprudential Commentary)
why_relevant: Companion narrative to the financial stability report; useful for banking-sector context that frames payment-market and retail-banking developments.

source_name: NBS – Ekonomický a menový vývoj (Economic and Monetary Developments)
why_relevant: Quarterly macro narrative; provides household consumption and retail-trade context that underpins card/POS volume interpretation, and occasionally boxes on payment behaviour.

source_name: NBS – Analytické štúdie / Policy Briefs
why_relevant: Longer policy-oriented studies; the venue for deeper treatments of e.g. cash demand modelling or payment-market structure that are too long for a commentary.

source_name: NBS – Výskumné a príležitostné štúdie (Working Papers / Occasional Papers)
why_relevant: Peer-review-grade research from NBS staff, mostly in English; the place where methodology behind cash-demand or payment-adoption estimates is documented in full.

source_name: NBS – Biatec, odborný bankový časopis (archive 1993–2019)
why_relevant: Discontinued NBS banking journal with a deep per-year, per-issue archive. Best historical narrative source for the pre-2020 evolution of Slovak payment systems, card acceptance, ATM networks and cash logistics.

source_name: NBS – Platby / Payments section (institutional narrative pages)
why_relevant: Standing explanatory pages on SIPS, TARGET-SK/TARGET2, instant payments, verification of payee and payment-system oversight objectives. Provides the institutional framing and definitional layer needed to read the payment statistics correctly.

source_name: NBS – Bankovky a mince / emisia (banknotes and coins section)
why_relevant: Cash-side institutional narrative: issuance programme, coin denominations (incl. the NBS analysis that 1- and 2-cent coins no longer effectively circulate), exchange of legacy Slovak koruna money, counterfeit information. Directly relevant to cash-usage intelligence.

source_name: NBS – Metodika odboru štatistiky (statistics methodology note, PDF)
why_relevant: Methodological note explaining how NBS compiles transaction data (direct vs indirect method, revaluations, reclassifications). Essential for interpreting revisions and breaks in the payment/monetary series.

source_name: NBS – Metodické informácie a oznamy (statistical collection portal methodology notices)
why_relevant: Running stream of methodological notices to reporting entities — the earliest signal that a payment-statistics definition, template or XML schema is changing, which foreshadows breaks in the published series.

source_name: NBS – Metodické usmernenia, stanoviská a odporúčania (supervisory methodological guidance)
why_relevant: Supervisory methodological guidance and opinions addressed to banks and payment institutions; defines how payment-service rules are applied in practice in SK and thus what market participants must report or disclose.

source_name: NBS – Prístup do platobných systémov NBS (July 2025 document)
why_relevant: Concrete example of the NBS 'dokument' download endpoint: a July 2025 explanatory document on access to NBS payment systems, tied to opening SIPS/TARGET-SK to non-bank PSPs from 6 October 2025 — a structural change to the SK payments market.

source_name: NBS – Ochrana finančného spotrebiteľa: bežné účty, platobné služby, elektronické bankovníctvo a platobné karty
why_relevant: NBS consumer-facing explanatory layer on payment products; states operative facts such as contactless no-PIN thresholds and card/e-banking mechanics. Useful as the authoritative definitional reference when interpreting card and POS statistics.

source_name: NBS – Téma NBS / thematic explainers (e.g. digital money, digital euro)
why_relevant: 'Téma NBS' longer-form explainer format inside the aktuality stream; covers digital euro and the future of cash vs digital money from the SK central-bank perspective. Signals NBS's stance ahead of formal policy.

source_name: NBS legacy site tree (www.nbs.sk/sk/publikacie/... and /_img/documents/...)
why_relevant: Pre-redesign NBS site tree still serves many historical PDFs (annual-report chapters by year, supervision reports, statistics methodology). Indispensable for long time series of narrative documents that the new nbs.sk navigation no longer surfaces.

source_name: NBS EN mirror of the publications tree (nbs.sk/en/publications/)
why_relevant: English mirror of most NBS narrative series. Note the mirror is partial and titles are sometimes left in Slovak — cross-language matching is needed to detect which SK items lack an EN translation (and therefore are SK-only intelligence).

source_name: ÚVO – Vestník verejného obstarávania (Slovak Public Procurement Bulletin)
why_relevant: Legally mandated publication venue for all above-threshold Slovak public tenders. Notices for ATM servicing, cash processing, payment terminals and card acceptance for public bodies (ministries, Sociálna poisťovňa, state banks, hospitals, transport operators) appear here with CPV codes and estimated values, which act as a hard quantitative proxy for fleet sizes and transaction volumes.

source_name: ÚVO – Vyhľadávanie zákaziek (tender search)
why_relevant: The operational query interface over the Vestník; allows CPV/keyword/contracting-authority filtering, which is the practical entry point for building a longitudinal series of SK public payment/ATM/cash procurements.

source_name: ÚVO – Vyhľadávanie profilov / profil verejného obstarávateľa
why_relevant: Every contracting authority (incl. NBS, Slovenská pošta, state banks, Sociálna poisťovňa) has a legally mandated profile aggregating its notices, contracts and award documents. It is the fastest way to enumerate the actor map of public buyers of payment/cash infrastructure and then snowball into their documents.

source_name: Centrálny register zmlúv (CRZ) – Central Register of Contracts
why_relevant: Signed contracts of state bodies, public-law institutions and (since 2022) municipalities/VÚC are published in full text under §5a of Act 211/2000. Payment-service, card-acceptance, cash-transport and ATM-servicing contracts appear here with prices, volumes, unit fees and annexes — the single richest public source of hard commercial terms in the SK payments market.

source_name: Zmluvy.gov.sk – legacy/alternate CRZ front-end
why_relevant: Alternative listing interface over the Central Register of Contracts organised by institution; useful when the main CRZ search is rate-limited or when enumerating all contracts of a specific buyer (e.g. Slovenská pošta).

source_name: TED – Tenders Electronic Daily (EU OJ Supplement)
source_subtype: EU-level procurement gazette with API/bulk data
why_relevant: All above-EU-threshold Slovak contracting-authority notices are duplicated here in structured eForms/XML with CPV codes, values and award results. Superior to the national bulletin for machine processing and for cross-border comparison of ATM/POS/cash-handling contracts.

source_name: data.europa.eu – TED procurement notices dataset
why_relevant: Bulk, reusable XML/RDF distribution of TED notices (and mirrors of Slovak data.gov.sk datasets), enabling offline longitudinal analysis of SK payments-related procurement without hammering the live portals.
